hillaire-park-4484.detail: "hillaire-park" keeps the slug "hillaire-park" in WA/bellevue. The City of Bellevue publishes exactly one Hillaire Park. Its A-Z park index, which appears in the navigation of every Bellevue park page, carries the name once, and the park's own page gives 15803 NE 6th St, Bellevue, WA 98008 — an address the Census geocoder matched to Bellevue city, King County. The kept row carries that address. The held row's street_address is "East Lake Hills", a neighbourhood rather than an address, with no house number to resolve, and its coordinates sit 4.7 km west of the park the City documents. It is a second record of the same park with a worse location, not a second park: the City's inventory has nowhere to put it. It stays quarantined and status=pending, so nothing is published from it and nothing is lost from data.csv.
